summary: Lakeshore Acquisition III Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting that at its July 27, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, shareholders approved a charter amendment to extend the business combination deadline from August 1, 2026 to August 1, 2027, and a trust agreement amendment allowing up to twelve one-month extensions for $67,500 each. No price, premium, or advisors were mentioned. This is a routine SPAC extension vote, not a special-situation transaction.
